guidance: Keep feedback specific and kind. Separate wins, friction, and kudos. Action items must be concrete process/tooling changes with owners—not vague aspirations. Do not invent feedback the team did not raise.

children.title: Focus Area
children.guidance: Main theme or goal of the recent work period.

children.title: Win
children.guidance: Title each instance with the win in a short phrase, not "Win".

children.title: Detail
children.guidance: What worked and why the team should keep doing it.

children.title: Friction
children.guidance: Title each instance with the friction point, not "Friction".

children.title: Detail
children.guidance: What hurt, who it affected, and why it matters.

outline.title: Kudos
outline.guidance: Optional shout-outs. Wrapper is always present; add zero or more shout-outs.

children.title: Shout-out
children.guidance: Title each instance with the person or team name. Describe the recognition in this section body.

outline.title: Action Items
outline.guidance: Concrete process or tooling changes for next cycle.

children.title: Action
children.guidance: Title each instance with the improvement step, not "Action".

children.title: Improvement Step
children.guidance: Concrete change to process or tooling.
